title: Text size reaches the Ask box and the desk's bar
owns: app/main/ask.ts, app/renderer/ask/** (field.ts, styles.css), app/main/desk/view.ts, app/renderer/desk styles, app/main/page-prefs.ts FIXED_TYPE, the text-size hint copy, README/DEVELOPING/DESIGN lines that say the Ask box and desk keep their size

items.text:
Settings > Comfort & access > Text size (Default, Large 115%, Larger 130%) now reaches every page but the Ask box and the desk's 30 px bar, which keep their size (round 2 could not edit them: other packages owned them). Make both follow it, keeping the Ask box's typed-ahead changes (round 2's typeahead package: the box shows before the screen read and keeps letters typed into it) intact. css2's proposal: Done or confirmed (the verifier agrees):
- The terminal's type follows the text size (49e98a2, 789c5cd, 37b8c76).
- The prompt card's per-card sizes: `const want = forText(size)` is already in windows.ts on the base.
- Allow and Not now are topmost and inside the window at every size (allow-top.mjs).
- Buttons, pop-ups and fields grow with the text (6bf0fe0, 632dcf5).

Left, because css2 may not edit those files this round:
- The Ask box (app/main/ask.ts, app/renderer/ask/**, owned by typeahead2).
- The desk's 30 px bar (app/main/desk/**, owned by lifecycle2).

Proposals for the lead to queue after the merge (for example with handle2, or as a follow-up package):
(1) Ask box: ask.ts SIZE width 560*s, height 25+67*s and LINE 24*s; field.ts FIELD.line/oneLine times --text-scale; ask/styles.css html[data-text-size] twins. Then drop 'ask' from page-prefs' FIXED_TYPE, 'The Ask box keeps its size.' from the hint, and the README/DEVELOPING/docs-test wording.
(2) Desk: view.ts bar height times the scale, desk/styles.css twins, and drop 'desk' from FIXED_TYPE.

Until then, the hint, DESIGN.md, README and DEVELOPING.md correctly say both keep their size.
